text: In isogenic human APOE3 vs APOE4 iPSC-derived neurons, lysosomal proximity ligation assays showed APOE4 neurons contain less lysosomal LGALS3BP and more lysosomal TMED5 - the two proteomic changes the paper links causally to lysosomal alkalinization in APOE4 cells (reported: qualitative (both PLA signals changed, ~2x lower LGALS3BP and ~1.5x higher TMED5 by eye)).
description: Isogenic human female APOE4 and APOE3 iPSCs differentiated into mixed (including GABAergic) neurons, DIV49; repurposed proximity ligation assay between lumenal LAMP1 and LGALS3BP or TMED5; three independent differentiations. Caveat: measures a mechanistic intermediate (lysosomal protein levels), not pH; human neurons rather than astrocytes.

provenance.excerpt: In concordance with our observations in Neuro-2a cells, we found that APOE4 iPSC-derived neurons harbored less lysosomal LGALS3BP and more lysosomal TMED5 compared to their APOE3 counterparts (Figure 6B,C).
